ADC_RULES

Table to store a single rule.

Columns
cru_id

PK, technical key

cru_crg_id

FK, reference to ADC_RULE_GROUP

cru_name

Descriptive name

cru_condition

Condition, syntactically in the form of a partial where clause

cru_sort_seq

Sort criterion defining execution order

cru_firing_items

List of page items referenced within cru_condition

cru_active

Flag indicating whether the rule should currently be used

cru_fire_on_page_load

Flag indicating whether this rule should fire when the page is initialized

cru_has_error

Flag indicating whether this rule contains an error

References
cru_crg_id

references ADC_RULE_GROUPS (crg_id)
